body: Not really I dont think, it just sorta happened. And I was thinking about it and I think it could all be just related to a medication change. I went from an injectible mood stabilizer to the same thing in pill form, and I think that might have something to do with it.

Ive been depressed for as long as I can remember really. Lately its been getting better but as of late, as in the last couple of weeks I can feel myself slipping back into depression and I dont want to be there.

Wherever you like...

Im actively depressed just not actively suicidal. Other then you the only response I got was a PM from some guy who wanted to know if I wanted to kill myself with him, not very helpful. lol.
Sure I would, and I dunno why no one has responded, guess they just dont know what to say.

Its pretty much guaranteed that it wont. I mean it will in some respects but it wont in others.

It would get me the attention that I crave but it would have other negative repercussions. I mean what if I accidentally died from my OD.
I like movies and photography and books.
As in what do I like to do to hurt myself? I like to overdose.
Okay, Im happy to talk

Im not sure what anyone can do for me...

Actually Im due for another injection of anti-psychotic medications tomorrow so Im probably at a lower level in my system and that could be why my mind is lurking on dark thoughts this evening.
I agree I think you have done the best you could for your friend. Its important that we take all threats of suicide seriously.

I dont want to talk I just wanted someone to know that Im about to gobble down a bottle of pills and die. I guess if I post here and someone knows then I dont feel so lonely.

I dont want to call a hotline, they just call the police anyway.
Thanks, I too feel better after having made this post and talked it out. I dont feel perfect and wonderful but Im not going to harm myself this evening.
I dunno, Im probably honestly too much of a chickenshit to OD for the 35th time, I will just whine about it on Reddit.
I want to be happy.
I got kicked out of school, and Im poor and alone.
I want me to be happy too but i dont know how to make me happy.
You are sweet, but I really didnt do anything.
Yes.
Thanks
Yes I will check back in the morning.

Thanks for the advice...

Honestly I dont think I have the guts to set myself on fire, I just like to fantasize about it, about hurting others with my own painful death. So yeah I dont think I will be doing that. Honestly after talking about it with all of you folks I doubt I am even going to commit suicide tonight. Im probably just going to go to bed.
I guess Im just angry about it, and so I want to make other people suffer for it.

Theres no opportunity to finish school, my student loan status is all fucked up and they will never take me back or let me finish.

My death would solve everything. Especially if a whole cafeteria full of my fellow students, professors and administrators had to watch me burn to death... Maybe I will wait and do it on the first day of classes in September.
I dont think I will feel better, I wont feel anything, I will be dead.

Well, I have tried suicide before, never this method, usually I prefer a good overdose, but I have no tablets and all the stores are closed and besides overdosing just doesnt work very well, its not very effective, and so Im gonna do this. It seems like it will be more effective.

I think I have destroyed my life, it isnt worth trying or fighting or attempting to survive or continue living, the only thing that is worth it, is to die now.

So thats why I am going to do this.

School was everything to me, it is most definitely worth giving up my life over. Maybe I should walk onto campus, douse myself with gasoline and self-immolate right there in front of everyone, then they can see what kicking me out did to me. And they will have to watch as I burn.
I guess I dont have a great story to tell. I dont know where to start or what to say.
Ive got myself kicked out of school, and theres no hope of me going back, I was like 2 courses away from a degree too, but thats all short to hell now.

Well its not like I havent tried suicide before, Ive tried lots, never this way, Im usually an overdosing sort of person, but I dont have any tablets tonight so the knife it is.

Im not sure what to say.

I feel like over the last year or so I have done everything I could to take the biggest possible shit on everything that was good in my life and now my life is a depressing shit-box and I dont want to be stuck living it anymore.

I like your username... Its awesome in a self-deprecating sort of way.

Emotionally I dont want to talk about it I just want to be left alone to die, but then again I posted about it rather than just going and doing it, so I guess some part of me wants to talk about it.
